verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects through per-chat model selection, with tool calls, skills and MCP servers, so natural-language interaction with a codebase is evidenced. Debugging and troubleshooting are only implied by this general coding-agent chat, not documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of debugging/troubleshooting workflows (e.g. reading errors/logs, running tests, diagnosing failures), examples of natural-language debug queries, independent or hands-on corroboration.
